name: sqlglot
run_setup: echo "import os; _f = os.sysconf; os.sysconf = lambda n, _f=_f: -1 if n == \"SC_SEM_NSEMS_MAX\" else _f(n)" > "$(.venv/bin/python -c "import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_path(\"purelib\"))")/zz_sandbox_sem_limit.pth"
install: uv venv -q --allow-existing -p 3.13 .venv && uv pip install -q -p .venv -e '.[dev]' pytest
notes: The virtual environment lives in the repo folder (.venv), so the suite runs inside the run sandbox with no registry once installed.
The tests are unittest-style; pytest runs them (pytest is added at install, it is not in the project's dev extras) so the grader gets junit XML and node ids.
One existing test runs a bare `python`, so the commands put .venv/bin first on PATH.

-p no:subtests: pytest 9 reports a failing unittest subTest only as `SUBFAILED(...) node`, which the grader's failing-node pattern does not read; without the plugin the test itself is reported FAILED, as before pytest 9.
pytest does not run the 105 doctests that tests/test_docs.py adds through unittest's load_tests; `python -m unittest` does.
SKIP_INTEGRATION=1 skips the TPC-H executor tests; the integration-test submodule is not in the practice copy.

SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=0.0.0: sqlglot takes its version from git tags (setuptools_scm), and the stage-4-candidate/... tags on the starting commits are not versions, so an install at a tagged checkout fails without it.

run_setup and run_env come from the harness builder (harness/README.md, trials 12-17): the .pth line answers os.sysconf('SC_SEM_NSEMS_MAX'), which the macOS run sandbox refuses; grading runs outside the sandbox and does not need it.
